# Welcome to the UU Programming Cafe! {.r-fit-text data-background-color="#FFCD00"}

::: {.footer}
:::

## Code Along, Feel Empowered{background-image=images/DCC-Banner.png data-background-size="100%" data-background-position="right top" data-background-repeat="no-repeat"}

::: {.theme-section}

<br>

**An informal space for researchers, students and research support staff to learn from one another and share programming know-how**

- Meet people working with code across Utrecht University
- Pick up practical ideas and tools
- Bring questions, curiosity, and your laptop

:::

## How the café works{background-image=images/DCC-Banner.png data-background-size="100%" data-background-position="right top" data-background-repeat="no-repeat"}

::: {.theme-section}

<br>

**15:00 - Theme presentation or demo**  
A short, interactive introduction to a programming topic (usually up to 30 minutes).

**15:30 - Questions, conversation, and snacks**  
Ask questions, discussion, work on exercises.

**16:00 - Community programming**  
Work on your own project, troubleshoot a bug together, or discuss your issues with an engineer.

**17:00 - Wrap-up**

:::

## Facilitated by the UUDCC{background-image=images/DCC-Banner.png data-background-size="100%" data-background-position="right top" data-background-repeat="no-repeat"}

::: {.theme-section-small}

<br> 
<br>

The **UUDCC** connects teams across Utrecht University who support researchers in making the most of digital tools and expertise.

<br>

**How the UUDCC can help programmers**

- **Get guidance** on software and engineering, HPC and cloud computing, AI, and research data management
- **Build good practices** around open science, robustness, reproducibility and efficiency
- **Training, projects, tools, consultancy** 

Explore [uu.nl/dcc](https://www.uu.nl/dcc) or ask us where to start.

:::
